paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization with Diffusion Models

paper_problem.decision_variables: N continuous two-dimensional unit-square turbine coordinates scaled by side length L
paper_problem.objective: maximize annual energy production under one fixed or sampled wind-speed/direction condition
paper_problem.constraints: rectangular boundary and minimum pairwise spacing 2D=252 m
paper_problem.turbine_and_wake: NREL 5 MW, 126 m nominal rotor, FLORIS 4.1.1 GCH configuration

method.denoiser: three fully connected single-head GAT layers, hidden width 1024, paper LeakyReLU profile

paper_source_conflicts.field: initial layouts, steps and learning rate

paper_source_conflicts.source: GATConv internal LeakyReLU followed by GELU
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: paper LeakyReLU is primary; source GELU is separately named

paper_source_conflicts.source: milestone and cumulative dataset transitions are not closed
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: persist optimizer/model/EMA and append every valid evaluated round to a cumulative dataset

formal_protocol.primary_cases: fixed 30/40/50; diverse targets; transfer 30-to-40/50; GNN-vs-MLP and guidance 1/2/4/5 ablations
formal_protocol.baseline_boundary: non-contribution comparison algorithms are not package blockers under Plan006
formal_protocol.execution: paper-scale CUDA if admitted; all-core CPU remains compatible but is not used to conceal infeasible paper-scale training time

hpc.evaluator_backend: native multi-core C++ FLORIS-4.1.1 GCH reconstruction
parallel_regions: batched EDM forward/backward and Heun sampling

claim_boundary: Academic paper-first reconstruction trained from scratch; not author-original software, private-data replay, checkpoint replay, or bitwise FLORIS identity.
